title: Mideast live: Oil tanker struck by projectile in Strait of Hormuz off Oman
summary: An oil tanker was struck by a projectile in the Strait of Hormuz off the coast of Oman, causing damage but no casualties, the the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) said early Tuesday. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.
contentText: China is closely monitoring developments as the US lays out its plans ‌for the "economic asphyxiation" of Iran. Following the threat to Beijing's economic partner, China will “firmly safeguard ‌its own rights and interests,” a foreign ministry spokesperson said ‌on Tuesday. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.
